Something in your house breaks. Suddenly, you need information you haven't thought about in years.

The model number, warranty, last repair, or contact information for whoever serviced it. Those details are easy to overlook until you need them.

I created The Home Systems Record to help homeowners keep important information together in printable worksheets: https://garrettsdevdesk.etsy.com/listing/4596839999/home-maintenance-binder-printable-pdf

Sometimes the frustrating part of a home repair starts before anyone picks up a tool.

You're searching for a manual, wondering whether the warranty is still active, or trying to remember who handled the last repair. A little preparation can make those moments easier.

Try choosing one major appliance today. Find its model number, warranty information, and service history, then put those details in one place.

Your home doesn't necessarily need another planner. It needs a reliable place for important information.

Equipment details, warranties, repair records, and service contacts are much easier to use when they're organized together instead of scattered across drawers and inboxes.

That's the idea behind The Home Systems Record, a printable home reference pack: https://garrettsdevdesk.etsy.com/listing/4596839999/home-maintenance-binder-printable-pdf

A useful home maintenance record doesn't have to be complicated.

Start with four categories: equipment and model numbers, warranties and documents, shutoff locations and service contacts, and repair or replacement history. These are the details that become especially valuable when something needs attention.

Try making a one-page reference for your water heater or HVAC system. You can build the rest of your home record gradually.

A little home organization now can mean less scrambling when something goes wrong later.

Knowing where to find equipment details, repair history, and important contacts won't prevent every problem. But it can make the next step easier to figure out.

The Home Systems Record includes 12 printable worksheets to help organize those details: https://garrettsdevdesk.etsy.com/listing/4596839999/home-maintenance-binder-printable-pdf

Most of us don't think much about our home's equipment records until something stops working.

Then we're looking for model numbers, manuals, warranties, and the name of the person who fixed it last time. Keeping a simple reference can make those situations less frustrating, especially when several people share responsibility for a home.
